_note: UNAUDITED prototype. Worked examples generated by `engine examples` from the engine's own formulas (engine/src/calc.rs, called by the state machine). All integers are decimal strings in engine units (SPEC section 1): price 1e-8 USD, size 1e-8 base, USDC 1e-6, notional 1e-16 USD, rates in ppm, funding rate and premium 1e-9. Signed values use a leading minus. null = no value (no funding, no liquidation price, missing book side).

rounding.bankruptcyPrice: long: ceil((openNotional - rest) / size); short: floor; clamped to [1, MAX_PRICE]; bound = max(bp, mark - floor(mark * floor(mmf0 / 2) / 10^6)) for a long, min(bp, mark + ...) for a short
rounding.fee: ceil(notional * feePpm / 10^6 / 10^10): the payer pays at least the exact amount
rounding.fundingCredit: floor(-(size * mark * rate) / 10^19) USDC units credited to the account (negative: it pays, rounded up in size)
rounding.fundingRate: P = lower-middle median of the samples; rate = clamp(P + clamp(interest - P, -clamp, +clamp), -max, +max); no samples: none
rounding.liquidationPrice: long: the highest mark with E < MR; short: the lowest; E = balance * 10^10 + size * mark - openNotional; one price unit beyond it the account is not liquidatable
rounding.margin: sum over tiers of (part of the notional inside the tier) * fraction, then ceil(/10^6) in notional units; in USDC ceil(/10^10); imf' = max(imf, ceil(10^6 / leverage))
rounding.mark: index + clamp(median(bid, ask, lastTrade) - index, -band, +band), band = floor(index * markBandBps / 10^4); missing values = index
rounding.pnl: unrealised = size * mark - openNotional (exact, notional units); in USDC floor(/10^10) for gains and losses alike (a loss is rounded up in size)
rounding.premium: trunc((max(0, impactBid - index) - max(0, index - impactAsk)) * 10^9 / index); a missing side counts as the index
